licence.terms: "Please contact the following address if you wish to use the images on this page."
licence.scope: SIRIUS home page of Nagoya University / NAOJ (developers of SIRIUS), level 3 (nearest statement, on the instrument home page, not the page that serves the curves): the sentence is about images, and the contact address is not given in the text served to curl. The technical page SVO cites (http://www-ir.u.phys.nagoya-u.ac.jp/~irsf/sirius/tech/index_e.html) has no terms. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
